comment: The allowance for 'lighter-weight formats in lower-readiness contexts, provided a clear progression path... is established' is exactly right, but it lives only at design-principle level. The normative weight of the document sits in the component functional-requirement tables (Appendix C), whose Required rows encode connected-state, full-stack assumptions and nowhere reference this allowance. As drafted, the principle and the conformance machinery contradict each other, and the tables will govern procurement.
